name: State function missing empty-state fallback
description: Flags a function or event declared only inside a named State, with no empty-state fallback.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a function or event declared only inside a named `State`, with no same-named declaration in the script's empty state (directly on the script, outside any `State` block). Papyrus dispatches a call to the empty-state version when the script is not in a state that declares it, so a state-only declaration throws or fails silently at runtime. A parent empty-state declaration (via `Extends`) counts when it can be resolved; an unresolved parent is left unflagged rather than guessed at. Private helpers never called from outside a state that declares them are exempt. Remote events (`Type.OnSomething`) are skipped. Related but different: `state-function-signature` (signature match when an empty-state declaration already exists).
